description.text: Matt Pocock's agent skills for real engineering — grilling, spec/ticket flows, TDD, code review, domain modelling and more. Plug-and-play, not vibe coding.

Superpowers teaches Claude brainstorming, subagent driven development with built in code review, systematic debugging, and red/green TDD. Additionally, it teaches Claude how to author and test new skills.
Production-grade engineering skills covering every phase of software development: spec, plan, build, verify, review, and ship.
Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes: Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, Goal-Driven Execution

Collection of example skills demonstrating various capabilities including skill creation, MCP building, visual design, algorithmic art, internal communications, web testing, artifact building, Slack GIFs, and theme styling
Collection of document processing suite including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and PDF capabilities
A collection of skills for AI coding agents. Skills are packaged instructions and scripts that extend agent capabilities.
The agent skills I use every day, cleaned up so anyone can use them. They work
Claude API and SDK documentation skill for building LLM-powered applications
Recommends relevant Claude Academy courses, tutorials, and use cases when users ask how to use Claude
Appends two or three short follow-up questions after a substantive answer to help users check key facts, probe the reasoning, and notice missing context
